prompt: This watercolor illustration depicts a quiet theatre backstage scene. On the left, a woman in a blue dress sits on a wooden crate, her posture relaxed. Next to her stands a tall man in a black suit, holding a script loosely in one hand. In the center, a large potted fern with broad green leaves adds a touch of nature to the industrial setting. To the right of the fern, a young boy in a yellow shirt points toward a hanging costume rack filled with vibrant fabrics. Standing beside the boy is an older woman in a gray cardigan, looking at the costumes with interest. The man in the black suit is handing a small prop sword to the woman in the blue dress. There is no audience visible in this intimate behind-the-scenes moment. The soft washes of color blend gently, highlighting the textures of the fabric and the wood grain without sharp lines. The composition focuses strictly on these five distinct figures and objects, capturing a fleeting pause before the show begins. The spatial arrangement guides the eye from the seated figure on the left across to the interacting pair on the right.
